obligations.text: Establish, implement, document and maintain a risk management system for the system.
Develop the system using training, validation and testing data sets that meet the data governance quality criteria.
Draw up and keep up to date technical documentation (containing at least the Annex IV elements) before placing the system on the market.
Ensure the system technically allows automatic recording of events (logs) over its lifetime.
Design the system to be transparent enough for deployers to interpret its output and use it appropriately, with information provided to them.
Design the system so natural persons (recruiters) can effectively oversee it while it is in use.
Ensure an appropriate level of accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity throughout the lifecycle.
Complete the conformity assessment based on internal control (Annex VI), with no notified body, before placing the system on the market.
Register yourself and the system in the EU database before placing it on the market or putting it into service.
Design and develop the chatbot so that shoppers are informed they are interacting with an AI system, unless this is obvious from context.
Take measures to ensure a sufficient level of AI literacy among staff operating or using the system (the only general duty; no high-risk obligations apply).
Optionally follow voluntary codes of conduct for AI systems that are not high-risk.

rows.clarifying_question: What specific task will the AI tool perform, and who will its outputs affect? For example, does it screen job candidates, evaluate or monitor employees, answer customer questions, generate content, or help with internal documents?

obligations.text: As provider, ensure the synthetic image and text outputs are marked in a machine-readable format and detectable as artificially generated or manipulated, using effective, interoperable, robust and reliable technical solutions as far as technically feasible.

As deployer, disclose that image content constituting a deep fake has been artificially generated or manipulated. Disclosure is limited to noting the content's existence where the work is evidently artistic, creative or fictional.
No mandatory obligations apply, but the organisation should still ensure staff AI literacy and may follow voluntary codes of conduct.

rows.clarifying_question: What specific task does the AI perform in your hiring process? For example, does it target job ads, screen, filter or rank applications or CVs, evaluate candidates in interviews or tests, or only handle scheduling or answer candidate questions? And does its output influence decisions about who is shortlisted, interviewed or hired?
